dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you learning a foreign language?

dialogues.speaker: Ninan
dialogues.text: Haha, no, I'm not doing a formal course of study or anything. This is just to satisfy my own sense of curiosity.

dialogues.speaker: Ninan
dialogues.text: And please don't misunderstand me — I'll never open a client's letter to peek at what they're saying. Everything I know, the clients themselves told me to help me with my learning.

dialogues.speaker: Ninan
dialogues.text: I can't leave Natlan easily, so of course, I've got to learn as much as I can from the tourists who are here to visit.

dialogues.speaker: Ninan
dialogues.text: In return, I'll also teach them some phrases in our language.

dialogues.speaker: Ninan
dialogues.text: Writing down some blessings in our language for the outlanders is always a fascinating experience.
